newsitem.title: USA: Belmont Homes sets 3-for-2 stock split.
newsitem.headline: Belmont Homes sets 3-for-2 stock split.

text.p: Belmont Homes Inc., a manufactured home company, Thursday declared a three-for-two stock split that will be paid in the form of a 50 percent stock dividend.
The new shares will be distributed Nov. 1 to shareholders of record as of Oct. 15. Cash will be paid in lieu of fractional shares.
Belmont Homes, named after its hometown in Mississippi, has about 6.3 million common shares outstanding.
Belmont markets single- and multi-section manufactured homes through about 320 dealers and 450 sales centres primarily in the southern United States.
Its stock rose 50 cents to $22 on Nasdaq in late morning trading.
